dish: Okinawa soba with sanmai-niku and kamaboko, served as a set with the house curry rice
n: Okinawa Soba Cafe Tenten, Yaese (沖縄そばcafe てんてん)
w: A hilltop soba café in a converted house in Yaese, run by a chef who cooked for years in Paris and the Netherlands before moving to Okinawa. Its best-known order is the curry-rice and small Okinawa soba set; OTV's Okitive ranked it in its 2025 island-wide Okinawa soba picks, and the shop doubles as a Dutch homewares corner.

dish: Ebi soba (shrimp-broth soba) and Yaeyama soba
n: Kato Soba, Kabira, Ishigaki (嘉とそば)
w: A small soba shop on a coastal hill above Kabira whose speciality is a fragrant shrimp-broth soba with oil-free noodles, alongside a classic Yaeyama soba. Mapple's Kabira guide and Tabirai's Ishigaki soba column both feature it.
